newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grains, soy values little changed.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grains, soy values little changed.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf wheat, corn and soybean basis values were steady in quiet conditions, grain dealers said.

They noted nearby hard red winter wheat values may start to weaken soon as harvesting in the U.S. begins to gather pace. Weekly state crop reports indicated the Texas crop was three percent harvested, as of Sunday, but the upcoming weekend should see a significant increase in combining.
News that Iraq had cancelled a purchase of 150,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat and switched the purchase to up to 150,000 tonnes of Australian hard wheat weighed on the market.
